sentences.text: The dechlorinated refill bucket sits under the sink, labeled in Sharpie so no substitute teacher pours straight tap water again. Flakes drifted everywhere while gravel crunched across the counter and one triumphant kindergartner held the net upside down. "He's not dead, he's sleeping," Tomas announced, though Ms. Reyes quietly moved the net closer just in case. Per the laminated rota taped beside the aquarium, Thursday feeding duties belong to Table Four, not to whoever arrives first. Nobody volunteered to take the goldfish home over spring break until Dev's mom finally texted a reluctant yes. Every afternoon the sun slides across the pet corner, and Bubbles follows the bright stripe along the glass, nose to the warmth. Day nine: orange one hides behind the plastic castle whenever the recorder plays; possibly coincidence, possibly excellent taste. Somebody returned the Thanksgiving sign-up sheet with three names crossed out and a suspicious smear of orange marker. Next week the fourth graders will chart Peach's growth in centimeters against the flake rations recorded on the clipboard. Over the long weekend the filter hummed alone in Room 12, and Principal Vance stopped by twice with the spare key. Water temperature logged at 21 degrees Celsius during morning observations; nitrate strips remain in the science cupboard behind the beakers. Marisol swears Bubbles recognizes her, though Mr. Delgado keeps saying goldfish memory is longer than three seconds, actually. When the heater tripped the breaker in January, the whole feeding rota got rewritten around emergency thermometer checks. "Two pinches, not a fistful, Jayden — you'll cloud the whole bowl again." Between setups, the driver — a retired REME mechanic — explained the clutch to three fascinated extras. Each armored prop carries a fire extinguisher bolted inside the hull, hidden from every camera angle. The prop master wiped diesel off the Sherman's glacis plate before the lens got anywhere near it. Rain had streaked the fake mud on the hull, so the art department mixed another batch of fuller's earth. Production has confirmed that both armored vehicles were rented from a private collector under a strict no-live-fire agreement. A camera car kept pace with the rolling column, its stabilized arm floating over the lead vehicle's turret. What is the meaning of the word tank?
